name: Kanzhun Limited

profile.description: Kanzhun Limited operates BOSS Zhipin, China's largest mobile online recruitment platform, which connects job seekers and employers through a direct real-time chat model powered by AI recommendation and its proprietary Nanbeige recruitment large language model. Q2 2026 revenue was about RMB2.40B (+14.1% YoY), income from operations rose 32.6% to RMB863.2M, average monthly active users reached 70.2M (+10.4%), and paid enterprise customers reached 7.2M (+10.8%). Q3 2026 revenue guidance is RMB2.41-2.50B (+11.4% to 15.6%). FY2025 revenue was RMB8.27B with net income of RMB2.74B. The company holds roughly RMB21.0B in cash (per Yahoo Finance) against minimal debt, declared an annual dividend of about $230M, and completed more than $300M of buybacks year to date. Founded in 2014 by CEO Jonathan Peng Zhao; headquartered in Beijing.

innovation.analysis: Track Record (2/3): BOSS Zhipin's direct-chat recruiting model took the company from an RMB1.94B, loss-making business in 2020 to RMB8.27B revenue and RMB2.74B net income in FY2025, and it is now layering AI agents on top of that model [1][5]. That is one significant new revenue engine, not a multi-pivot reinvention. AI Deployment (2/2): The proprietary Nanbeige recruitment LLM, paired with DeepSeek, powers AI agents for job seekers and recruiters; management cited a 60% gain in time efficiency from AI agents and record user retention since 2020 [3]. Market Share (2/2): 70.2M average MAUs (+10.4%) and 7.2M paid enterprise customers (+10.8%) in Q2 2026 make BOSS Zhipin the largest online recruitment platform in China [2]. Pipeline (1/2): Management named four AI investment priorities, including a results-oriented recruitment model and small-model research, but gave no product launch dates or revenue targets [3]. R&D Intensity (1/1): FY2025 R&D of RMB1.65B was 20% of revenue, well above internet-platform peers [5].
innovation.label: STRONG

inspiration.analysis: Mission Floor (2/4): Kanzhun describes its purpose as making job matching more efficient for both job seekers and employers through mobile-native direct chat [1][6]. That is clear about what it does and for whom, but it does not reach for a bigger purpose. Community Impact (1/2): The company publishes an annual ESG report; its 2025 report (April 2026) describes general social programs and reports no data-privacy breaches or major compliance violations in 2025, but gives no distinctive, dollar-quantified community investment [6]. Employee Retention (0/2): No retention or tenure data was found. Insider Buying (0/2): Insiders hold about 0.07% of shares per Yahoo Finance, and no insider open-market buying was found. Shareholder returns come through company buybacks (more than $300M year to date) and the dividend, not insider purchases [2][5].
inspiration.label: WEAK

infrastructure.analysis: Mechanically scored as a Growth stock: BZ pays a ~3.1% yield, but its dividend record only starts in 2023 (2 consecutive years), short of the 5-year Dividend sleeve test. D/E 1.0% (score 1.0, 1x); ROE 23.9% (1.0, 2x); revenue growth 14.1% YoY (1.0, 1x); 5yr revenue CAGR 33.6% (FY2020 RMB1.94B to FY2025 RMB8.27B, derived from FMP statements; 1.0, 2x); Forward P/E 11.1 (1.0, 1x); profit margin 52.8% TTM per Yahoo (1.0, 1x; FY2025 GAAP net margin was 33.1%, and Q2 net income was lifted by large interest and investment income); Forward PEG 1.56 per Yahoo (0.72, 2x) [2][5]. Weighted sum 9.44 / 10 = 9.4, rounded to 9. Liquidity is well clear of the floor: 6.44M average volume x $16.54 = ~$106M a day.
infrastructure.label: STRONG

ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (5/9): Online recruitment is exposed to AI. AI matching agents could commoditize job-board intermediation, and AI-driven automation could shrink white-collar hiring volume, which CEO Zhao has acknowledged as a gradual labor-market effect [3][4]. BOSS Zhipin's defense is its two-sided network of 70.2M MAUs and 7.2M paying employers, plus its own recruitment LLM. Caixin's data shows software-engineer postings still grew 10.9% in early 2026, so AI has not yet dented hiring [2][4]. AI Opportunity (1/1): AI-related job-posting revenue more than doubled in Q1 2026, and AI agents are shipping to both sides of the platform; management says AI's opportunities outweigh its risks for its model [3][4].
ai_resilience.label: MODERATE

infinite_game.summary: Through Sinek's lens, Kanzhun is a well-run, founder-led operator still playing a mostly finite game. It survived a year-long 2021-2022 registration ban by rectifying its data practices and kept investing roughly 20% of revenue in R&D. But its stated purpose is about efficiency, not an ideal future state, and there is little public evidence of a Just Cause that would outlast its founder.

just_cause.analysis: 1/3 pts. The purpose of making hiring more efficient through direct chat is real but transactional. It describes a product advantage, not a future state people would sacrifice for. Management commentary focuses on efficiency, retention and monetization metrics rather than a cause [3][6].

trusting_teams.analysis: 1/2 pts. Founder Jonathan Peng Zhao has led the company since 2014, providing continuity [3]. No mass-layoff or culture red flags were found, but there is also no independent evidence of exceptional psychological safety or retention. Coverage notes his innovation has also brought governance challenges [3].

worthy_rivals.analysis: 0/1 pts. No management commentary was found that frames rivals such as Zhaopin or Liepin as worthy rivals to learn from. Public messaging centers on Kanzhun's own share and efficiency gains [1][3].

existential_flexibility.analysis: 1/2 pts. The company has adapted rather than reinvented itself. It rebuilt user registration after the 2021-2022 Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) cybersecurity review, moved into blue-collar and AI-agent recruiting, and is exploring overseas markets [3][7]. These are extensions of the core model, not a transformational pivot.

courage_to_lead.analysis: 1/2 pts. Kanzhun kept investing heavily in R&D (RMB1.5-1.8B a year) through the CAC review and is now committing resources to AI models while still returning more than $300M through buybacks [5][2]. That is one clear example of long-term investment, but the growing emphasis on capital returns gives no pattern of costly bets.

investment_thesis: Kanzhun is a high-quality cash machine trading at a value multiple. BOSS Zhipin grew revenue 14.1% in Q2 2026 to RMB2.40B, with operating income up 32.6%, and guides to 11-16% growth in Q3 [2]. Revenue has compounded at 33.6% a year since 2020, ROE is 23.9%, debt is essentially zero, and the stock trades at 11x forward earnings with a ~3% dividend yield plus active buybacks [5]. The proprietary Nanbeige LLM and AI agents are driving record retention and a 60% efficiency gain, and AI-related job postings more than doubled in Q1 2026, so AI so far adds to the platform's demand [3][4].
thesis_continued: The bear case starts with China. The 2021 CAC review froze new registrations for about a year and triggered shareholder suits, which shows how quickly regulators can halt growth [7]. Growth has slowed from 30%+ to low-teens, job-seeker paid services are shrinking (RMB14.6M vs RMB24.8M), and a weak Chinese labor market or AI-driven white-collar hiring cuts could cap enterprise spend [2][4]. The TTM 52.8% profit margin is flattered by investment income, and the 5-year PEG of 1.56 shows growth now priced near fair value. ADR and VIE structure risk remains for U.S. holders.
key_catalysts: Q3 2026 results against RMB2.41-2.50B guidance (+11.4% to 15.6%); an upside print would confirm the Q2 growth re-acceleration [2]
Monetization of AI agents and the results-oriented recruitment model built on the proprietary Nanbeige LLM, alongside AI-related job-posting revenue that more than doubled in Q1 2026 [3][4]
Continued capital returns: an annual dividend of ~$230M and more than $300M of 2026 buybacks against a ~$7.2B market cap [2]
key_risks: Chinese regulatory intervention: the 2021-2022 CAC cybersecurity review halted new user registration for about a year [7]
AI-driven reductions in white-collar hiring volume shrinking employer recruiting budgets, which management acknowledges as a gradual labor-market effect [4]
Growth deceleration and macro weakness in China's job market, with job-seeker value-added services already down ~41% YoY in Q2 2026 [2]
